stop||v.|(-pp-) 1. a. [不及物] 停下（She was walking toward me, then suddenly stopped. 她朝我走来突然停了；The bus stopped at the corner. 公交在拐角停；He stopped to watch the sunset. 他停下看日落；She had to stop to catch her breath. 她停下来喘气；He stopped to pick up a penny. 他弯腰捡便士；The car couldn't stop in time. 车来不及刹住；Stop! Who goes there? 站住！谁？；I stopped dead in my tracks. 我猛地停住。）。 b. [及物] 使停下（Stop that man! 叫住那人；They stopped us at the border. 他们在边境拦我们；She stopped the car. 她停下车；He was stopped by police for speeding. 他超速被警察拦下；The goalie stopped the ball. 守门员扑住球；The sight stopped me in my tracks. 那景象让我愣住。）。 2. a. 停止做（He never knows when to stop. 他不知道什么时候该停；It's time to stop and take a break. 该休息了；He stopped short of naming names. 他没点名；Did you ever stop to think? 你有没有停下来想过？；She never stopped to consider others. 她从不考虑别人；Stop what you're doing. 放下你手头的事；I stop work at 5. 我五点下班；The phone stopped ringing. 电话不响了；Stop arguing. 别吵了；She stopped smoking. 她戒烟了；The patient stopped breathing. 病人停止呼吸；His heart stopped beating. 他心跳停了；Stop it! 住手！）。 b. 阻止（I'm leaving and you can't stop me. 我走定了你拦不住；It's too late. There's no stopping them now. 现在拦不住他们了；I couldn't stop him from crying. 我没法让他不哭；He stopped himself from laughing. 他忍住笑；Nothing can stop me from leaving. 没什么能拦我走；We need to stop the disease from spreading. 我们要阻止疾病蔓延；There's nothing to stop you from going. 你大可以去。）。 3. [及物] a. 终止（The teacher stopped the fight. 老师制止打架；We need to stop the violence. 我们要制止暴力；They tried to stop the bleeding. 他们想止血。）。 b. 暂停（She stopped the CD. 她停了 CD；We stopped the movie to get snacks. 我们暂停电影拿零食。）。 4. [不及物] 停止发生（The music stopped. 音乐停了；The path stops halfway. 小路到半山就没了；The rain had stopped. 雨停了。）。 5. [不及物] 停止运转（The engine just stopped. 发动机突然停了；His heart stopped. 他心脏停了。）。 6. [不及物] a. 停留（We stopped for lunch. 我们停下来吃午饭；We need to stop for gas. 我们得加油；We stopped for a night in Atlanta. 我们在亚特兰大过夜。）。 b. 顺路停留（The tour stops in several cities. 巡演在几个城市停留；I'll stop for a short visit. 我会顺道拜访。）。 c. 短暂拜访（I'm not stopping. 我不留，放下就走。）。 7. [及物] 堵塞（He stopped his ears. 他捂住耳朵；She stopped up the cracks. 她堵住裂缝；The sink is stopped up. 水槽堵了。）。 8. [及物] a. 通知银行止付（I called to stop payment on the check. 我打电话通知支票止付。）。 b. 主要英式，扣除（£200 will be stopped from your wages. 你工资里扣 200 英镑。）。 9. [不及物] 英式非正式，逗留（I am stopping at home. 我待在家。）。 stop at nothing 不择手段。 stop by 顺访（Feel free to stop by anytime. 随时来坐。）。 stop in 1. 顺访。 2. 英式，待在家。 stop off 中途停留（I'll stop off to pick up milk. 我顺路买牛奶；She's stopping off in Miami. 她在迈阿密停留。）。 stop out 英式，在外过夜。 stop over 中途停留（The plane stops over in Chicago. 飞机在芝加哥经停；She stopped over at a friend's. 她在朋友家暂住。）。 stop up 英式，熬夜。 n. [可数] 1. a. 停止（The car slowed to a stop. 车缓缓停下；The ball rolled to a stop. 球停了；The train came to a stop. 火车停了。）。 b. 终止（Production was brought to a stop. 生产停止；Negotiations brought a stop to the conflict. 谈判结束了冲突；Work came to a stop. 工程停了；The fighting came to a sudden stop. 战斗突然停了；put a stop to these practices 制止这些做法；put a stop to the rumors 制止谣言。）。 c. 体育，扑救（The goalie made a great stop. 守门员精彩扑救。）。 2. a. 停留地（His first stop will be Washington. 他第一站是华盛顿；Our first stop is the gas station. 我们先去加油站。）。 b. 停留（an overnight stop in Paris 在巴黎过夜；We'll make a stop at the museum. 我们顺道参观博物馆。）。 3. a. 站点（a bus stop 公交站；The next stop is Main Street. 下一站主街；I'm getting off at the next stop. 我下站下。）。 b. 美式，停车标志处（a four-way stop 四向停车；a stop sign 停车标志。）。 4. 止付（I put a stop on the check. 我通知止付这张支票。）。 5. a. 音栓。 b. 音栓拉手。 6. 语音，塞音。 pull out all the stops 全力以赴。[古英语]|||||||||||

take||n. & v.|/过去式 took；过去分词 taken；现在分词 taking/ —v. 1. 拿，取，握（take the pan by the handle 握住锅柄）。2. 携带、带走（take an umbrella with you 带上伞；the bus will take you downtown 公交车送你到市中心）。3. 取得、赢得（take first prize 获一等奖）；攻占（take the city at dawn 拂晓攻克城市）；夺走（Thieves took the painting from the museum. 窃贼从博物馆盗走了那幅画）。4. 抓走、俘获（take sb. prisoner 俘虏某人）；偷走（Someone has taken my pen. 有人拿走了我的笔）。5. 乘坐（take the bus 乘公共汽车）；沿……走（take the next turning on the left 在下个路口左转）。6. 服用、吃、喝（take medicine 服药；Do you take cream in your coffee? 你咖啡里加奶油吗？）。7. 需要、花费（It will only take a minute. 只需一分钟）；容纳（The elevator will take a few more people. 电梯还能再上几个人）。8. 接受、收取（take the offer 接受提议；Do you take credit cards? 你们收信用卡吗？）；承受、容忍（I can't take it anymore. 我再也受不了了）。9. 进行、做（take a walk 散步；take notes 记笔记；take an oath 宣誓）。10. 拍摄、记录（take a photograph 拍照；take his address 记下他的地址；take her temperature 给她量体温）。11. 选择、担任（take a job 接受工作；take the initiative 采取主动）；选修、参加（take piano lessons 上钢琴课；take the test 参加考试）。12. 理解、以为（I took you to mean yes. 我以为你的意思是同意）；把……当作（Do you take me for an idiot? 你把我当白痴吗？）；以某种方式对待（took it badly 对此很难受）。13. 减去（take 3 from 9 9 减 3）。14. 使吃惊（Her reaction took me by surprise. 她的反应让我大吃一惊）；染上、受（take fire 着火；take fright 受惊）。15.（植物、种子等）生根、成活；（接种等）见效（The transplant didn't take. 移植没有成活）。16.（语法）接（宾语）（This verb takes an object. 这个动词接宾语）。—n. [可数] 1. 收入、所得（a large take 一大笔收入）。2.（电影、歌曲的）一条镜头或录音（It took 20 takes to get it right. 拍了 20 条才拍好）。3. 看法、见解（What's your take on this? 你对这件事怎么看？）。短语与搭配（保留英文）：take after 长得像（He takes after his father. 他长得像他父亲）；take apart 拆开；（口语）击败；严厉批评；take away 拿走、减去；外卖（take-away food 外卖食品）；take back 收回（话）；退回（商品）；使想起；take down 记下、取下、拆除；take in 收留；欺骗（be taken in 受骗）；理解（Did you take that in? 你听懂了吗？）；改小（衣服）；包含；take off 起飞、突然离开、脱下、迅速走红（Her career took off. 她的事业一飞冲天）；take on 承担、呈现（take on a new meaning 呈现新义）、同……较量、雇用；take out 取出、邀请外出（take sb. out to dinner 请某人出去吃晚饭）；take over 接管（take over the company 接管公司）；take to 喜欢上、开始（take to drinking 开始酗酒）；take up 开始从事（take up the guitar 开始学吉他）、占据（take up half the room 占半间屋子）、继续；take it easy 放松、别紧张；take it or leave it 要么接受，要么拉倒；take place 发生；take action 采取行动；take sides（take sb.'s side）支持某一方；be taken aback 大吃一惊（She was taken aback by his rude response. 他粗鲁的回答让她大吃一惊）；be taken ill 突然生病；be taken with/by 被……迷住；on the take（美，非正式）受贿、捞油水。|||||||||||

under||prep.|1.（位置）在……下面，在……底下：They couldn't climb over the wall, so they dug a hole under it.（他们翻不过墙，就在墙下挖了个洞。）；Draw a line under each word you don't know.（在你不认识的词下面画线。）；We sat under a tree and rested a while.（我们在树下坐了一会儿。）；I'm wearing a sweater under my jacket.（我夹克里面穿了件毛衣。）；The ball rolled under the car.（球滚到车底下去了。）；How long can you hold your breath under water?（你在水下能憋气多久？）2.（管理、指导）在……之下：The cafe is under new management.（这家咖啡馆换了新老板。）；She has 12 employees (working) under her.（她手下有 12 名员工。）3.（受某种状态、影响、控制）：He has been under a lot of pressure/stress at work lately.（他近来工作压力很大。）；The roof collapsed under the weight of the snow.（屋顶被雪压塌了。）；The work was done under the direction of an architect.（这项工作在一位建筑师指导下完成。）；Driving while under the influence of alcohol is dangerous.（酒后驾车既危险又违法。）；I was under the impression that admission was free.（我原以为免票。）4.（处于某种过程或状态中）：The police put her under arrest.（警察逮捕了她。）；The house is under construction.（房子正在建造中。）；The incident is currently under investigation.（事件正在调查中。）；His suggestion is still under discussion.（他的建议仍在讨论中。）5. 根据，依照：Under the terms of the lease, rent will be due on the first of each month.（按租约条款，每月一日交租。）；They have fulfilled all their obligations under the treaty.（他们已履行条约规定的全部义务。）6. 归入（某一类别或名称）：The purchase is listed under “debits.”（这笔购置记在“借方”项下。）；The table is reserved under my last name.（餐桌是以我姓氏预订的。）7.（数量、年龄）低于，少于：All the children in the class are under the age of 14.（班上所有孩子都不满 14 岁。）；We arrived in under an hour.（我们不到一小时就到了。）8.（外表之下）隐藏在：Under that rough exterior, he is a kind and gentle man.（他外表粗鲁，内心却善良温柔。）—adv. 1. 在下面，往下面：Pull the bed sheets tight then fold the ends under.（把床单拉紧，边角塞到下面。）；The whale surfaced briefly then dove under again.（鲸鱼露出水面，随即又潜入水下。）2.（数量）低于：A score of 60 is needed to pass; anything under is failing.（60 分及格，低于 60 分不及格。）；Children aged five and under may enter the park for free.（五岁及以下儿童可免费入园。）3. 进入麻醉或昏迷状态：They had to put me under for surgery.（他们不得不给我麻醉后做手术。）|||||||||||

[+宾] 了解（某人的想法、感受）：I understand him well enough to know that he won't want to go.（我很了解他，知道他不会想去。）；She understands children.（她懂孩子。）；At first we didn't get along, but I think we understand each other now.（起初我们合不来，但我想现在我们彼此理解了。）b. 体谅，同情：She had a similar experience, so she understands what I'm going through.（她有类似经历，所以能体会我此刻的处境。）；I can understand your/you feeling annoyed.（你觉得恼火是可以理解的。）；They will understand if you need some time off.（你需要请段假的话他们会体谅。）4. [+宾] 理解为，解释为：I understood the letter to be a refusal.（我把这封信理解为拒绝。）6. [+宾]（词语）不言而喻的：When people say “they're engaged,” the phrase “to be married” is understood.（人们说“他们订婚了”时，“将要结婚”之意是不言而喻的。）|||||||||||

unload||v.|（-loads; -loaded; -loading）1. 卸货：[+宾] It took four hours to unload the truck.（卸卡车花了四个小时。）；Could you help me unload the car?（你能帮我把车上东西搬下来吗？）；[无宾] Most ships unload at another dock now.（现在多数船在另一个码头卸货。）2. [+宾] 让（乘客）下车、下船：The train made several stops to unload passengers.（火车停了好几站让乘客下车。）3. [+宾，非正式] 抛售，脱手：He's trying to unload his old car.（他急着把旧车卖掉。）；She unloaded a huge amount of stock when prices fell.（价格下跌时她抛出大量股票。）4. [+宾] 取出（胶卷、子弹、碗碟）：unload film from the camera（从相机里取出胶卷）；unload a gun（退出枪里的子弹）；He unloaded the dishwasher and put away the dishes.（他从洗碗机里拿出碗碟放好。）5. [无宾，非正式] 倾诉：I really need to unload. Do you have a few minutes?（我真得倒倒苦水，你有空吗？）6. [无宾，美，非正式] 发泄；猛击：The coach really unloaded on the players after the game.（赛后教练把队员痛骂了一顿。）；He unloaded on the pitch and drove it over the right field wall.（他猛力一击，球飞过右外野围墙。）|||||||||||

up||adv.|1. 向上：The land rises up from the valley.（土地从山谷升起。）；Pull up your pants.（把裤子提起来。）；Keep your head up.（把头抬起来。）2. 朝上：He looked up at the stars.（他抬头看星星。）3. 浮出水面：The dolphin came up for air.（海豚浮上水面换气。）4. 向北；往重要处：She flew up from Florida.（她从佛罗里达飞来。）；He went up to London.（他上伦敦去了。）；Their daughter is up at Oxford.（他们的女儿在牛津上学。）5. 走近：I walked up to her and said “hello.”（我走到她跟前说“你好”。）6. 起立：Please stand up for the national anthem.（奏国歌请起立。）7. 起床：What time did you get up this morning?（你今早几点起的？）；I stayed up late last night.（我昨晚熬夜了。）8. 加大：Please speak up.（请大声说。）；Could you turn the volume 暖气开大吗？）；The price of oil went up.（油价上涨了。）9. 上进：He grew up on a farm.（他在农场长大。）10. 出现：The missing ring turned up.（丢失的戒指找到了。）；They never showed up.（他们根本没露面。）11. 搭建：We should put the tents up first.（我们应该先把帐篷搭起来。）12. 提出：He brought up the issue at the meeting.（他在会上提出了这个问题。）13. 完成：He filled up the gas tank.（他把油箱加满。）14. 封上：He sealed up the package.（他把包裹封好。）15. 分成：She tore 剪开。）16. 激起：She stirred up the fire 煽动人群。）17. 停下：He pulled the car up at the curb.（他把车停在路边。）up and down（来回；上下）：He paced up and down in the waiting room.（他在候诊室里踱来踱去。）—adj. 1. 向上的：the up escalator（上行扶梯）。2. 起床的：Are the kids up yet?（孩子们起来了吗？）。3. 上涨的：Gas prices are up again.（油价又涨了。）4.（非正式）发生什么事：What's up?（怎么了？）；Something's up with her.（她有点不对劲。）5. 领先的：The team was 10 points up.（这支队伍领先 10 分。）6. 运转的：The system 网络又恢复了。）7. 轮到你：You're up next.（下一个轮到你。）8. 结束：Time is up.（时间到。）up against（面对）：The problem we are up against is a difficult one.（我们面临的问题很棘手。）up for（打算参加；待售）：She is up for reelection next year.（她明年要竞选连任。）；Our house is up for sale.（我们的房子要卖。）up to（多达；由……决定；忙于）：Up to eight people can play the game.（这游戏最多八人玩。）；It's up to you.（由你决定。）；What are they up to?（他们在搞什么鬼？）—prep. 向上；沿：He climbed up the ladder.（他爬上梯子。）；Go up the street and turn left.（沿街走，然后左转。）—n. [可数] 上升期：The company has had more ups than downs this year.（公司今年顺境多于逆境。）；We have had our ups and downs.（我们有过沉浮。）on the up and up（诚实可靠；蒸蒸日上）。—v.（ups; upped ; upping）[+宾] 提高：The restaurant upped its prices.（餐馆涨价了。）up and（突然……）：One day, he just upped and left home.（有一天他突然离家出走了。）|||||||||||

-y||suffix|（亦作 -ey） 1 形容词后缀：a 充满……的、多……的 • muddy（泥泞的）• dirty（脏的）b 有……特质的；由……制成的 • gooey（黏糊糊的）• waxy（蜡状的）c 像……的 • icy（冰冷的）• wintry（寒冬般的）• homey（像家一样的）d 对……很感兴趣的 • outdoorsy（爱好户外活动的）2 a 易于……的 • chatty（健谈的）；想要……的 • sleepy（困倦的）b 引起……的；会……的 • a drowsy afternoon（令人昏昏欲睡的下午）• curly hair（卷发）3 名词后缀 ：做某事的行为 • inquiry（询问）4 见 -ie|||||||||||
-y1||suffix|形容词后缀 [古英语]：1 由名词、形容词构成，表“充满……的、具……性质的”（messy 凌乱的）；沉溺于……的（boozy 豪饮的）2 由动词构成，表“倾向于……的、易于……的”（sticky 黏的）|||||||||||
-y2||suffix|（亦作 -ey、-ie）指小名词、昵称等后缀（granny 奶奶；nightie 睡衣）[源自苏格兰]|||||||||||
-y3||suffix|名词后缀，表状态、情况或性质 [拉丁语 -ia，希腊语 -eia]：orthodoxy（正统）|||||||||||
-yer||suffix|见 -er（第 2 义）|||||||||||
